mapper.select:
select fbri.rate_type rateType, fbri.rate * 100 rate, fbri.index_id indexId, fbri.index_source indexSource, fbri.coefficient, fbri.spread_rate *100 spreadRate, fbri.reset_type resetType, fbri.publish_type publishType, fbri.rate_lower *100 rateLower, fbri.rate_limit *100 rateLimit, fbri.remark from fin_base_rule_info fbri where fbri.finprod_id = #{periodProdId}
and fbri.branch = #{branch} and fbri.eff_date = ( select max(t1.eff_date) from fin_base_rule_info t1 where t1.base_rule_id = fbri.base_rule_id and t1.eff_date <= STR_TO_DATE(#{platDate},'%Y-%m-%d') ) and fbri.base_rule_type = #{baseRuleType}

select fcpr.cash_id cashId, fcpr.eff_date effDate, fcpr.pay_cycle_val payCycleVal, fcpr.pay_cycle payCycle, fcpr.day_type dayType, fcpr.day_value dayValue, fcpr.end_tday_rule endTdayRule, fcpr.pay_tday_rule payTdayRule, fcpr.calc_rule calcRule, fcpr.first_pay_date firstPayDate, fcpr.cash_unit_type cashUnitType, fcpr.finprod_id finprodId, fcpr.finprod_type finprodType, fcpr.finprod_type2 finprodType2, fcpr.branch, fcpr.pay_type payType, fcpr.remark from fin_cash_pay_rule fcpr where fcpr.cash_id = #{periodCashId} and fcpr.eff_date = ( select max(eff_date) from fin_cash_pay_rule where eff_date <= STR_TO_DATE(#{platDate},'%Y-%m-%d') )

select fcpr.cash_id cashId, fcpr.eff_date effDate, fcpr.calc_type calcType, fcpr.base_type baseType, fcpr.base_date_type baseDateType, fcpr.basis, fcpr.yield, fcpr.is_initial isInitial, fcpr.finprod_id finprodId, fcpr.finprod_type finprodType, fcpr.finprod_type2 finprodType2, fcpr.branch, fcpr.remark from fin_cash_calc_rule fcpr where fcpr.cash_id = #{periodCashId} and fcpr.eff_date = ( select max(eff_date) from fin_cash_calc_rule where eff_date <= STR_TO_DATE(#{platDate},'%Y-%m-%d') )

select fcpr.cash_id cashId, fcpr.eff_date effDate, fcpr.base_rule baseRule, fcpr.ast_vdate_type astVdateType, fcpr.act_rule actRule, fcpr.remark, fcpr.base_type baseType, fcpr.base_date_type baseDateType, fcpr.basis from fin_float_calc_rule fcpr where fcpr.cash_id = #{periodCashId} and fcpr.eff_date = ( select max(eff_date) from fin_float_calc_rule where eff_date <= STR_TO_DATE(#{platDate},'%Y-%m-%d') )
mapper.sql:
select t.validStatus, t.periodProdId, t.periodId, cast(t.investCycle as char) investCycle, t.publishType, t.rateType, t.rateLower, t.rateLimit, t.rate, t.indexId, t.coefficient, t.spreadRate, t.resetType, t.termType, t.baseRule, t.startDate, t.endDate, t.p_finprod_id as finprodId, t.branch from( select '有效' validStatus, ftp.finprod_id periodProdId, ftp.period_id periodId, ftp.term investCycle, ftp.vdate startDate, ftp.mdate endDate, fbri.publish_type publishType, fbri.rate_type rateType, fbri.rate_lower *100 rateLower, fbri.rate_limit *100 rateLimit, fbri.rate * 100 rate, fbri.index_id indexId, fbri.coefficient, fbri.spread_rate *100 spreadRate, fbri.reset_type resetType, fpa.term_type termType, case when fbri.publish_type = #{publishType01} then CONCAT_ws('', CONCAT_ws('', cast(fbri.rate_lower *100 as decimal(4,7)) , '~') , cast(fbri.rate_limit *100 as decimal(4,7))) when fbri.rate_type = #{calcType01} then cast(fbri.rate * 100 as decimal(4,7)) when fbri.rate_type = #{calcType02} then CONCAT_ws('', fbri.index_id ,'*', fbri.coefficient ,'+', cast(fbri.spread_rate*100 as decimal(4,7))) end as baseRule, fp.p_finprod_id, ftp.branch from fin_trade_product ftp left join fin_product fp on fp.finprod_id = ftp.finprod_id left join fin_base_rule_info fbri on fbri.finprod_id = ftp.finprod_id and fbri.branch = ftp.branch left join fin_product_add fpa on fpa.finprod_id = fp.finprod_id
inner join PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY ppa on fpa.PORTFOLIO_ID = ppa.PORTFOLIO_ID and ppa.USER_ID = #{userId}
where fbri.eff_date = ( select max(t.eff_date) from fin_base_rule_info t where t.base_rule_id = fbri.base_rule_id and t.branch != 0 and t.eff_date <= STR_TO_DATE(#{platDate},'%Y-%m-%d') ) and fbri.base_rule_type = #{baseRuleType01} and ftp.finprod_type2 = #{F26} ) t
and t.p_finprod_id in
#{item}
and t.startDate >= STR_TO_DATE(#{startDateBegin},'%Y-%m-%d')
and t.startDate <= STR_TO_DATE(#{startDateEnd},'%Y-%m-%d')
and t.endDate >= STR_TO_DATE(#{endDateBegin},'%Y-%m-%d')
and t.endDate <= STR_TO_DATE(#{endDateEnd},'%Y-%m-%d')
